_note: Pages are set by hand, from the 2026-11-05 audit. A sweep must not restore anything listed in `deleted`, must not create a landing page where `landing` already points, and must not overwrite `landing` or `app`. `product` is the exception the 2026-11-05 sweep could not see: a root-level .html that is not a Pages page but IS what the product ships (index.html is the README's download and what server.js serves at /). Never delete a `product` file, and never re-add it to `deleted`.
